domesticDestinations.name: Rajasthan
domesticDestinations.tagline: Royal Palaces, Forts & Thar Desert Glamping
domesticDestinations.overview: Experience regal hospitality across Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, and Jaisalmer. Stay in historic heritage palaces, embark on private desert camel safaris under starlit skies, and savor lavish royal thalis.

domesticDestinations.name: Shimla Manali
domesticDestinations.tagline: Snow Peaks, Alpine Pine Valleys & Thrilling Passes
domesticDestinations.overview: Breath-taking Himalayan panoramas, cedar forests, colonial heritage on Shimla's Mall Road, and high-altitude adventures in Solang Valley and Rohtang Pass.

domesticDestinations.name: Kerala
domesticDestinations.tagline: Tranquil Backwaters, Tea Plantations & Ayurvedic Wellness
domesticDestinations.overview: Cruise serene palm-fringed backwaters aboard private luxury houseboats, wander misty tea gardens in Munnar, and rejuvenate with authentic Ayurvedic spa therapies.
inclusions: All Meals on Houseboat + Daily Breakfasts

domesticDestinations.name: Andaman
domesticDestinations.tagline: Emerald Lagoons, Coral Reefs & Radhanagar Beach
domesticDestinations.overview: White sandy beaches, turquoise lagoons, and world-class scuba diving. From Port Blair's Cellular Jail to Havelock's Radhanagar Beach (ranked among Asia's best).

internationalDestinations.name: Dubai
internationalDestinations.tagline: Futuristic Skylines, Luxury Desert Safari & Royal Marina
internationalDestinations.overview: Ascend Burj Khalifa's 148th floor At The Top Sky, race across golden red dunes in private 4x4 desert safaris, cruise Dubai Marina on a luxury yacht, and indulge in world-class shopping.
inclusions: Private AC Luxury Vehicle for All Transfers
Burj Khalifa & Marina Yacht Charter Tickets

internationalDestinations.name: Singapore
internationalDestinations.tagline: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands & Sentosa Island
internationalDestinations.overview: Marvel at Avatar-like Supertree structures, walk through the Cloud Forest dome, take a cable car across to Sentosa Island, and enjoy nightlife along Clarke Quay.
inclusions: Universal Studios & Gardens by the Bay Passes

internationalDestinations.name: Bali
internationalDestinations.tagline: Private Pool Villas, Sacred Temples & Nusa Penida Cliffs
internationalDestinations.overview: Wake up in a private jungle pool villa in Ubud, visit the dramatic sea temple at Uluwatu, swing over emerald Tegallalang rice terraces, and speed boat to the white sands of Nusa Penida.
inclusions: Nusa Penida Island Speedboat Day Tour

internationalDestinations.name: Maldives
internationalDestinations.tagline: Overwater Coral Villas & All-Inclusive Island Indulgence
internationalDestinations.overview: Pure tropical barefoot luxury. Sleep directly above vibrant turquoise lagoons in private overwater villas, snorkel with sea turtles and manta rays, and enjoy curated sandbank dining.
inclusions: All-Inclusive Plan: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner & Drinks
